scope: Minimal service-worker protocol reproduction, not the full application acceptance run.
method: Real installed Chrome + temporary loopback server serving current service worker source. Diagnostic-only response header exposed the incoming Request.cache. Product dist was not changed. Page reload happened after context.setOffline(true).
fix: Only X-Vesluma-Map-Retry: 1 bypasses validated CacheStorage entries. HTTP cache modes reload/no-store alone do not disable the offline map. Explicit app retries still use cache: reload to refresh HTTP cache.
limitation: This isolates service-worker cache semantics. Full application acceptance uses the final rebuilt bundle and is reported separately.
